milestones.description: Pinned versions, re-verified capability matrix, resolved conflict register, ADR amendments.

milestones.title: M2 — Stage 1: Provider and transport spikes
milestones.description: Throwaway spikes proving gates G1-G5. Recorded protocol fixtures. No production code.

milestones.title: M3 — Stage 2: Normative spec v0.1
milestones.description: OAC spec + security spec + conformance fixtures. Interfaces frozen at stage exit.

milestones.title: M4 — Stage 3: Core and fakes
milestones.description: Core types, policy, identity, fakes, in-memory transport, contract suites. CI green with no providers.

milestones.title: M5 — Stage 4: Adapters and Zenoh transport
milestones.description: Real adapters and transport built against frozen contracts.

milestones.title: M6 — Stage 5: End-to-end and threat verification
milestones.description: ADR validation criterion on three platforms; security tests; acceptance criteria 1-10 mapped to passing tests.

milestones.title: M7 — Stage 6: Release hygiene
milestones.description: Docs, license inventory, deferred list, known risks, upgrade notes.

milestones.title: M8 — Agent enablement
milestones.description: Progressive-disclosure skill tree that guides agents through the plan.
